description: EX-LIFE, retained owners. Phase 1: process a opens exclusive read/write, holds a table recordset and a TableDef, releases only the Database (no Close), then closes/releases the recordset, then the TableDef; process b tries DAO shared read/write after each point (Errors before/after, count read). Phase 2: a on a created Workspace opens exclusive, BeginTrans, updates a row, releases the Database and recordset without Close, keeps the Workspace; b tries; a Rollback; b tries; a releases the Workspace; b tries and reads the row (final independent read). Asks which retained object keeps the exclusion, and whether a transaction owner does.
